children: The Singapore dollar consolidates against its U.S. counterpart, but could be supported by declining crude oil prices. Maybank analysts note in a report that Saudi Arabia's East-West pipeline requires five to six weeks to repair after a recent drone attack. However, other estimates suggest repairs could only take a week, they note. There is likely more room for oil prices to decline, which could ease pressure on Asian currencies, Maybank says. The U.S. dollar is little changed at 1.2754 Singapore dollars, LSEG data show. (amanda.lee@wsj.com)
